052df4f53731f34a4e2d4dfb020e3fd765d0f5cb:
query FlxSetupSettingsScreen {
  flxSetupSettings {
    ...FlxSetupSettingsFields
  }
  flxSetupConnection {
    ...FlxSetupConnectionFields
  }
  flxSetupSources {
    ...FlxSetupSourceFields
  }
  flxSetupCloud {
    ...FlxSetupCloudFields
  }
  flxSetupTelemetry {
    ...FlxSetupTelemetryFields
  }
  flxSetupGraphqlStatus {
    state
    version
    phpVersion
    phpMin
    phpOk
    actionUrl
    actionLabel
  }
}

fragment FlxSetupCloudFields on FlxSetupCloud {
  connected
  title
  text
  note
  error
  manageUrl
  postUrl
  flash
  flashType
  hidden
  hideDays
  actions {
    action
    label
    nonce
    kind
  }
}

fragment FlxSetupConnectionFields on FlxSetupConnection {
  state
  title
  message
  host
  site
  checked {
    iso
    label
    relative
  }
  checkedLabel
  backingOff
  hasKey
  keyFromConfig
  packageCount
  updateCount
}

fragment FlxSetupSettingsFields on FlxSetupSettings {
  server
  defaultServer
  serverFromConfig
  effectiveServer
  hasKey
  keyFromConfig
  auto
  health
  usageAvailable
  usage
  legal {
    kvkk
    privacy
    terms
  }
}

fragment FlxSetupSourceFields on FlxSetupSource {
  id
  name
  url
  type
  main
  enabled
  hasKey
  state
  message
  packageCount
  canMoveUp
}

fragment FlxSetupTelemetryFields on FlxSetupTelemetry {
  enabled
  status
  url
  defaultUrl
  payload
  options {
    id
    title
    text
    label
    on
  }
}
